uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

1031-2134-4050-8240.description:
Cast Bond of Insight by paying {3}{U}.
Grandmother Goby and Invocation of the Founders trigger.
Resolve the Grandmother Goby trigger, countering Bond of Inisght and creating four 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Resolve the Invocation of the Founders trigger, copying Bond of Insight.
Resolve the copy of Bond of Insight, causing each player to mill four cards and then returning the original Bond of Insight and up to one other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing the four Merfolk tokens, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

2105-4478-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

728-967-3809-4772-7087.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

222-527-647-728.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4186-5256-6566--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 5.

5662-5686--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5662-5686--5--195.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reyhan trigger.
Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2557-4826-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-3680.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-3680.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Stunt Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-3680.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

527-3249-4824.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Selvala.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Havengul Lich triggers, giving it Selvala's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Havengul Lich using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Soliton.
Cast Soliton by paying its mana cost.
Havengul Lich triggers, giving it Soliton's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Havengul Lich using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping Havengul Lich.
Activate Havengul Lich using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Repeat from step 8.

1322-1368-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1322-1368-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

140-3238-3245.description:
Activate Phyrexian Colossus by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

2558-5315-7422--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-5315-7422--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Garrison Excavator triggers. Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

475-4321-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-4321-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

539-997-7085.description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5205-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

413-5276-6767.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Rescue Skiff trigger, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

38-323-5220-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

955-1402-2644-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4890-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Dack's Duplicate
4890-5299-5466.description:
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Dack's Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Dack's Duplicate's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Dack's Duplicate's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Dack's Duplicate's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

3918-4038-5034.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sol Ring's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

1020-3689-4908-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1580-2018-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Reassembling Skeleton from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from steps 1 and 5
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

224-4862-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-4862-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
If the sacrificed creature was an Elemental, Omnath's second ability triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath's first ability and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a 5/5 Elemental creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

2713-4050-4790-4891.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Atsushi that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Atsushi token, adding {1}.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

309-1656-4762.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
309-1656-4762.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Llanowar Vanguard's ability by tapping it, giving it +0/+4 until end of turn.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once Necrotic Ooze has infinite toughness, you may instead use Devoted Druid's first ability to get infinite green mana.

2232-3094-3475-4753-4768.notablePrerequisites:
The World Spell has exactly two lore counters on it.
You have at least one non-Saga enchantment card in hand.
2232-3094-3475-4753-4768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The World Spell triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
The World Spell's third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and targeting it, copying The World Spell's trigger.
Resolve the copy of The World Spell's trigger, putting Clever Impersonator and any non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Choose to have Clever Impersonator enter the battlefield as a copy of The World Spell, with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Clever Impersonator triggers once, and Cloudstone Curio and Altar of the Brood each trigger twice.
Resolve both Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Clever Impersonator and any other non-Saga enchantment from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, putting it and the non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 5.

2358-2713-3260-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's third ability by paying {W}, causing you to gain five life.
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying three life, adding {W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may use Blood Celebrant to get infinite colored mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's other abilities.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-3129.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-3129.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting six +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

3573-4954.notablePrerequisites: You control at least nine artifacts.
3573-4954.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least nine {U}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {8}, causing Tolarian to become a 8/8 Elemental with haste, and untapping Tolarian Academy.
Repeat.
